description: Defines an abstract class NotesSyncService for synchronizing notes, with methods to push and pull notes.

classes.name: NotesSyncService
classes.description: An abstract class providing methods for synchronizing notes between client and server.

methods.name: pushNotes
methods.description: Asynchronously pushes a list of notes to the sync service.

methods.name: pullNotes
methods.description: Asynchronously pulls notes from the sync service that have been updated since the specified time.
